caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a ceramic or clay jug shaped in the form of a seated man. The man is wearing a tricorn hat, a long coat with visible buttons, breeches, and shoes, all of which are depicted in shades of brown. He has detailed facial features including a prominent nose, pronounced cheeks, and a visible open mouth. The man is holding a cup with both hands close to his chest, and his legs are bent at the knees as he sits. The jug is designed so that the opening is at the top of the brim of his hat. The base of the object is rectangular, and it is shaded in varying tones of brown with darker areas used to indicate shadows and depth. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or elements present.
title: Brown Pottery Toby Jug
